info.title: LQEpoch Cross-Language Contracts
info.description: Versioned JSON projections only. No HTTP endpoint is declared by trading-core. uint64 fields use canonical decimal strings to preserve JavaScript precision; Rust and Python consumers must reject numeric, leading-zero, and overflow forms. Rust validation enforces invariants that JSON Schema cannot express exactly. Numeric encoding is explicit: binary-float shortest-decimal values require a raw-frame SHA and remain unqualified.

UtcTimestamp.description: UTC RFC3339 timestamp with canonical minimal fractional precision.

ExactDecimalString.description: Exact bounded JSON-number token encoded as a string; Rust ExactDecimal applies exponent, scale, and coefficient bounds.

NonNegativeDecimalString.description: Exact non-negative decimal token. Quote values may be zero; trade values must be strictly positive.

PositiveDecimalString.description: Exact bounded decimal token strictly greater than zero; Rust ExactDecimal applies exponent, scale, and coefficient bounds.

MarketDataSourceV1.description: A synthetic source must use provider=synthetic, feed=synthetic, and numeric_encoding=decimal_token. Binary float values are shortest-decimal projections and are not source-exact or contract-qualified.

StockTradeV1.description: Rust validation rejects zero or negative trade price and size.

symbol.description: Compact or six-column-padded OCC symbol candidate; full contract qualification requires provider evidence.

OptionTradeV1.description: Rust validation parses OCC through domain::OptionSymbol and rejects zero or negative trade price and size.

MarketEventEnvelopeV1.description: Proto oneof payload maps to the Rust Serde kind-tagged object. uint64 JSON fields are canonical decimal strings; Rust validates event/control semantics. Binary float projection requires raw_frame_sha256 of the original provider frame; source-exact precision and contract qualification are not implied.

ConnectionStatusV1.description: Connected state does not acknowledge any subscription.

SubscriptionAckV1.description: At least one result is required. Combined accepted and rejected counts must be <=32, and symbol identities must be unique and disjoint across arrays; Rust enforces the cross-array rule.

ControlEventEnvelopeV1.description: Proto oneof payload maps to the Rust Serde kind-tagged object. uint64 JSON fields are canonical decimal strings; Rust validates event/control semantics. Binary float projection requires raw_frame_sha256 of the original provider frame; source-exact precision and contract qualification are not implied.

DatasetTimeRangeV1.description: Half-open source_timestamp range. Receive time never fills absent source timestamps.

object_name.description: ASCII basename only; no path separators, wildcard characters, dot, or dot-dot.

object_id.description: Opaque provider identity; never use it as a local path. local-test identifiers have a restricted traversal-safe tail.

source_pages_exhausted.description: Paged sources must set true. Non-paged or synthetic sources leave it absent.

dataset_id.description: Immutable identity, not a family/latest selector; Rust also rejects dot-dot and latest/fallback identity tokens.

items.description: UTF-8 identity, 1..256 bytes, no edge whitespace/control characters; internal OCC root padding is allowed.

DatasetManifestV1.description: Exactly one immutable Parquet object per manifest. readback_sha256 equals object.content_sha256; footer rows equal row_count. raw_messagepack_bytes and raw_json_bytes are valid only with their matching registered raw-frame schema fingerprints, no source-time range, and every frame timestamp missing; Rust and shared consumers enforce cross-field equality. Legacy weekly archive manifests are a different schema and require explicit rejection or conversion.

ForecastHorizonV1.description: End-of-day session horizons omit value; registry validation binds id, unit, value, and label.

PredictionSourceV1.description: dataset_id equals train_dataset_version and refers to an immutable DatasetManifestV1; manifest_sha256 hashes the exact manifest bytes. numeric_encoding is copied from the bound DatasetManifestV1 source.

ForecastSnapshotV2.description: Causal ordering and elapsed/session endpoint constraints are validated by quant-contracts.

PredictionEnvelopeV1.description: This read-only envelope is not execution authority. Quant validation binds model fields, dataset version/hash, manifest hash, horizon, data cutoff and causal clocks to ForecastSnapshotV2.

UInt64String.description: Canonical decimal string for protobuf uint64. The uint64 format validator must reject values above 18446744073709551615; parsers must reject JSON numbers and leading zeros.

PositiveUInt64String.description: Canonical uint64 decimal string greater than zero.

ProtoTimestampV2.description: Canonical UTC ProtoJSON timestamp. Fraction precision is 0, 3, 6, or 9 digits; the V2 Rust projection preserves nanoseconds.

DatasetSourceV2.description: Same provider-neutral source message as market v1. Entitlement text is an observation, not authorization evidence.

object_id.description: Opaque storage identity; never a path. Local test IDs must use a traversal-safe local-test tail.

FiniteBatchSealReceiptV2.description: Canonical non-circular ProtoJSON projection whose exact compact UTF-8 bytes, without a trailing LF, are hashed by FiniteBatchCompletionV2.seal_receipt_sha256. Hash binding is not issuer or provider-completeness evidence.

seal_receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact compact ProtoJSON bytes from FiniteBatchSealReceiptV2, excluding this field and with no trailing LF.

FiniteBatchCompletionV2.description: Input counts must be equal and non-zero. Times satisfy cutoff <= sealed <= completed, and manifest source-time coverage ends no later than cutoff. A seal proves processing of this finite input, not provider history completeness or provider truth.

ProviderWatermarkCompletionV2.description: Structural observation only. sequence_count must equal last_sequence - first_sequence + 1 with checked arithmetic. Generation is scoped by immutable subscription instance and may repeat after process restart. Only a fixed trusted verifier can inspect receipts and qualify a watermark; callers cannot self-assert completeness.

DiagnosticStreamCompletionV2.description: Diagnostic evidence only. The local cutoff and maximum observed source timestamp do not mean complete_up_to or prove provider completeness.

DatasetCompletionEvidenceV2.description: Exactly one oneof case is required. This is canonical OpenAPI snake_case; ProtoJSON camelCase field names are also accepted by generated bindings.

DatasetManifestV2.description: Exactly one immutable object. Storage readback is separate from source completion. Hashes identify bytes but do not verify their issuer or qualify provider completeness. Current Alpaca streams do not provide a trusted watermark, so they remain unverified/diagnostic. finite_batch seals one finite input only; local_archive is not provider-history proof. Finite source-time coverage must end at or before the exclusive data cutoff. Manifest SHA-256 must cover the complete serialized bytes; no self-hash field is included.

NumericEncodingV1.description: Protobuf enum names are NUMERIC_ENCODING_*; UNSPECIFIED is omitted and rejected. raw_messagepack_bytes and raw_json_bytes are allowed only on DatasetManifestV1 values whose object schema fingerprint identifies the matching registered raw-frame schema; both are rejected for normalized event and prediction messages.

UsEquityTradeBarV2.description: One-minute US equity trade-only bar. uint64 values are canonical decimal strings and timestamps preserve nanoseconds. completion_evidence_sha256 must equal the canonical ProtoJSON SHA-256 of the unique DatasetManifestV2 completion_evidence oneof. The digest is an internal reference and does not authenticate a receipt issuer or qualify provider completeness.
